test_numeric_comparisons: test numeric comparisons between Series, Index, and scalar values for equality and ordering operations
test_division_by_zero: test division by zero behavior for Series, Index, and DataFrame with correct inf and nan handling
test_numeric_timedelta_arithmetic: test multiplication and division of numeric arrays with timedelta scalars and arrays
test_addition_subtraction: test addition and subtraction of Series and DataFrame with aligned and misaligned indices
test_ufunc_compatibility: test numpy ufunc compatibility with pandas Index, Series, and RangeIndex for operations like sin, sqrt, and modf
